reviews.title: Sounds bad even with eq too cheap, connectivity good but
reviews.comment: The Bluetooth worked great, seemed great but the audio quality is trash, the drivers literally sound so cheap. Trying to eq them nothing could change how the drivers sounded like paper. Ill either look for other ones or just use my wired synthesizer 6xx. Of you know good audio dont buy these , if you dont care about audio quality at all then go for it. Also the 7.1 surround sound is bs,  you have to PAY FOR A SUBSCRIPTION to a razor program to use it
